infobox.usage: Unlocks a passageway in the administration building (D3) on Terminal.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Black Division keycard (BD) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: It seems the Black Division operatives have somehow prepared a working access keycard. It should also work on doors at the seaport.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In a Weapon box (6x2) inside the seaport terminal building (MS) on Terminal. A single keycard is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to a passageway in the administration building (D3) on Terminal.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: Way to the pumping station building.
